prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. A family seen from behind, their faces never visible, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, stands waiting before a great closed square door of rough pitch-black timber in dim light, thin bright lines of daylight at its edges. Dim light through the cracks. Patient. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
